;Arts and culture
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on television]]
***Actor [[Daniel Dae Kim]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/19/entertainment/daniel-dae-kim-coronavirus/index.html (CNN)]
*The wreckage of the [[USS Stickleback (SS-415)|USS Stickleback]] is discovered off the [[Hawaiian Islands|Hawaiian Island]] of [[Oahu]]. [https://www.livescience.com/cold-war-submarine-wreck-hawaii-coast.html (Live Science)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]] unveil a $1 trillion economic [[CARES Act|stimulus package]] proposal to aid businesses and the American public during the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/19/politics/coronavirus-economic-stimulus-senate-republicans/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***The [[European Union]]'s chief [[Brexit]] negotiator, [[Michel Barnier]], tests positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-eus-brexit-negotiator-michel-barnier-tests-positive-for-covid-19-11960128 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****In [[Italy]], the military is deployed to the city of [[Bergamo]], [[Lombardy]], the Italian city worst hit by COVID-19, to collect and transport the bodies of dead residents to [[crematorium]]s in other cities, as Bergamo’s authorities say their facilities can no longer process the large number of fatalities. The city's mayor [[Giorgio Gori]] says the true number of dead could be much higher than what's been reported.  [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-italian-army-called-in-to-carry-away-corpses-as-citys-crematorium-is-overwhelmed-11959994 (Sky News)]
****The number of confirmed COVID-19 deaths in Italy overtakes the number in China, as 3,405 are now confirmed dead due to the virus. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-51955509 (BBC News)]
****Marcello Natali, a doctor from [[Italy]] known for exposing the country's chronic shortage of medical supplies, dies from the coronavirus. The Italian Federation of General Practitioners confirms his death. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/19/marcello-natali-italian-doctor-who-exposed-supply-shortage-dies-from-coronavirus/ (''New York Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Northern Ireland]] confirms its first death from COVID-19, an elderly man with an underlying medical condition who was being treated at a hospital in [[Greater Belfast]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-51958241 (BBC News)]
****The COVID-19 death toll in the [[United Kingdom]] rises to 144. [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-03-19/number-coronavirus-deaths-cases-england-uk-rise-nhs-128/ (''ITV News'')]
****The British government introduces the [[Coronavirus Bill 2019–21]], which would grant it extensive discretionary emergency powers in managing the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-51964163 (BBC News)]
****The British government puts 20,000 [[British Army]] reservists on standby to help with the coronavirus pandemic. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-britain/uk-puts-military-on-standby-queen-addresses-anxious-nation-idUKKBN2160X7 (Reuters)]
****[[Transport for London]] announces the closure of 40 train stations, including [[London Waterloo station]] and the [[Hammersmith & City line]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2020/mar/19/london-tube-to-close-many-stations-because-of-coronavirus (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Monaco]]
****[[Albert II, Prince of Monaco]], tests positive for COVID-19, becoming the world's first [[head of state]] to test positive for the virus. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-coronavirus-prince-albert-monaco-21720586 (''Daily Mirror'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] says the country’s COVID-19 death toll has risen to 767, with 169 more deaths and 3,431 new confirmed cases, for a total of 17,147 cases. [https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/spain-coronavirus-death-toll-soars-to-767-1.70500890 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]], in its daily [[National Health Commission]] report, lists no new domestic COVID-19 cases for the first time since the coronavirus pandemic began in [[Wuhan]]. [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/china-reports-no-new-domestic-coronavirus-cases-for-first-time-national-health-commission/articleshow/74703935.cms (''The Economic Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]]'s [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] reports 149 more COVID-19 deaths and an additional 1,046 cases, bringing the death toll in the country to 1,284 and its total number of cases to 18,407. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran/irans-death-toll-from-coronavirus-rises-to-1284-idUSKBN2161O4 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****Nepalese government orders the suspension of all classes and the postponement of all academic examinations. [https://myrepublica.nagariknetwork.com/news/90755/ (''My Republica'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[Australia]] closes its borders to all non-Australian residents. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-australia/australia-closes-borders-to-coronavirus-pumps-56-billion-into-economy-idUSKBN2160JJ?il=0 (Reuters)]
****[[Australia|Australian]] [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] says about A$100 billion will be injected into the [[Economy of Australia|Australian economy]] to support it during the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/australia-economy-to-get-a-dollar56-billion-coronavirus-protection-injection/ar-BB11ookf (MSN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]]
****[[Fiji]] reports its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a male patient in [[Lautoka]]. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/world/news/article.cfm?c_id=2&objectid=12318204 (''The New Zealand Herald'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
***[[Russia]] reports its first death from COVID-19. [[Moscow]] city authorities say the victim was a 79-year-old woman with underlying health conditions. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-death/first-coronavirus-death-reported-in-russia-which-plans-to-quarantine-all-new-arrivals-idUSKBN21615H?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The number of COVID-19 cases in the [[United States]] surpasses 10,000, with 13,229 confirmed cases. The death toll stands at 195. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/03/health/us-coronavirus-cases-state-by-state/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.wsj.com/articles/china-reports-no-new-domestic-coronavirus-infections-for-the-first-time-since-outbreak-started-11584611233 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
****The [[United States State Department|U.S. State Department]] warns American citizens not to travel abroad due to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/19/politics/state-department-travel-advisory/index.html?utm_term=1584648603477837c7fd86089&utm_source=Breaking+News&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=155001&bt_ee=kXywcRzipNYLMfUaVOBmL9RvLrnkrXsVE0JWUcPSSrptWyteZB3STUZSnhb4MaWQ&bt_ts=1584648603494 (CNN)]
****[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
*****While educational facilities close across the [[United States]] due to the coronavirus pandemic, the [[United States Department of Education|U.S. Department of Education]] tells educators that [[educational technology|online learning]] must comply with [[civil and political rights|civil rights]] laws, including making sure learning tools are available to students. However, as not every student has access to the [[internet]], many students will be unable to participate, prompting some public school systems to implement "enrichment" policies. Under these policies, [[coursework]] completed under [[educational technology|online learning]] will not officially count towards advancing to the next [[academic term]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/schools-closed-for-coronavirus-online-work-wont-count-11584643049 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****Six counties in the [[San Francisco Bay Area]] announce [[shelter in place]] orders for all residents due to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.sfchronicle.com/local-politics/amp/Bay-Area-must-shelter-in-place-Only-15135014.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
*****[[Los Angeles County]], [[California]], announces a near-lockdown, urging residents to stay in their homes and to only go out in public for essential needs. [https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/news/california/story/2020-03-19/los-angeles-county-announces-near-lockdown-all-residents-urged-to-stay-home-except-for-essential-needs?_amp=true& (''The San Diego Union-Tribune'')]
*****[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all Californians except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services. [http://www.pbs.org/newshour/amp/nation/california-governor-issues-stay-at-home-order-amid-coronavirus-outbreak (''PBS NewsHour'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****Two more people die from COVID-19 in [[Michigan]] and the total number of cases in the state rises to 334. The two fatalities are identified as an 81-year-old and a woman in her 50s with underlying health conditions. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/03/two-more-coronavirus-deaths-reported-in-michigan.html (MLive)] [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/03/michigan-coronavirus-cases-jump-to-336-with-increase-of-private-testing.html (MLive<sub>2</sub>)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hawaii]]
*****[[Hawaii]] says that it will not allow the passengers of two cruise ships heading for its coast to disembark upon arrival due to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic, despite both ships reporting zero cases of COVID-19. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/reported-coronavirus-hawaii-cruise-ship-passengers-disembark/story?id=69683821 (ABC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
*****[[New York City]] [[Mayor of New York City|Mayor]] [[Bill de Blasio]] says the city's COVID-19 death toll stands at 22, with 3,615 cases. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/03/19/new-york-city-has-3615-confirmed-coronavirus-cases-including-an-inmate-at-rikers-island-mayor-de-blasio-says.html (CNBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
*****[[Florida]] [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Rick Scott]] urges those visiting the state for [[spring break]] to stay away from public beaches to avoid the spread of the coronavirus. [https://www.sun-sentinel.com/coronavirus/fl-ne-florida-beaches-coronavirus-20200319-45upiema4vdftanmkreuph7kk4-story.html (''Sun-Sentinel'')]
*****In an effort to prevent those visiting the state for [[spring break]] from gathering on beaches amid the ongoing coronavirus pandemic, [[Governor of Florida|Florida Governor]] [[Ron DeSantis]] institutes [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] guidelines preventing large crowds and says "the party’s over." However, he stops short of closing all public beaches in the state, despite calls for him to do so. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/19/florida-governor-says-partys-over-for-spring-breakers-amid-coronavirus-crisis/ (''New York Post'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]]
*****[[List of governors of Pennsylvania|Pennsylvania Governor]] [[Tom Wolf]] orders all non-life-sustaining businesses in the state to close physical locations to slow the spread of the coronavirus. [https://www.wgal.com/article/all-non-life-sustaining-businesses-in-pennsylvania-ordered-to-close-physical-locations-to-stop-coronavirus-spread/31789626/ (WGAL)]
*****The first COVID-19 death in [[Pennsylvania]] is reported, an adult from [[Northampton County, Pennsylvania | Northampton County]]. He was being treated at a hospital prior to his death. There were no specific details released on the patient or his health prior to contracting the virus. [https://www.wgal.com/article/wolf-administration-announces-pennsylvanias-first-death-related-to-coronavirus/31753649/ (WGAL)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (U.S. state)]]
*****[[List of governors of Georgia|Georgia Governor]] [[Brian Kemp]] says he does not plan on ordering business to close or shutting down public events amid the coronavirus pandemic. [https://www.news4jax.com/news/local/2020/03/19/gov-brian-kemp-to-address-covid-19-in-georgia/ (WJXT)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] reports its first death from COVID-19, a 41-year-old [[diabetes|diabetic]] man. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-mexico-tally/diabetic-man-becomes-mexicos-first-coronavirus-death-idUKKBN216058?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Haiti]]
****[[Haiti]] confirms its first two cases of COVID-19. [https://www.voanews.com/science-health/coronavirus-outbreak/haiti-confirms-its-first-coronavirus-cases (Voice of America)]
****Amid the coronavirus pandemic, [[Haiti]] declares a [[state of emergency]]. All schools, universities, industrial parks and airports will be closed from midnight, while a nationwide [[curfew]] will be in force from 8pm to 5am. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-haiti/haiti-declares-emergency-over-coronavirus-imposes-curfew-shuts-border-idUSKBN21700V (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[Syria–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] calls for the [[Syrian government]] to release journalist and veteran [[United States Marine Corps|Marine]] [[Austin Tice]], arguing the "U.S. has done a lot for [[Syria]]". [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/trump-calls-on-syria-to-release-journalist-austin-tice/ (CBS News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2020 Congressional insider trading scandal]]
**According to an article published by the [[ProPublica]], [[United States Senate|Senators]] [[Richard Burr]] of [[North Carolina]], [[Kelly Loeffler]] of [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[Jim Inhofe]] of [[Oklahoma]], and [[Dianne Feinstein]] of [[California]] sold their stocks before the [[2020 stock market crash|stock market crash]]. [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/sen-richard-burr-sold-stock-stock-market-coronavirus (Fox News)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/richard-burr-coronavirus-kelly-loeffler-dianne-feinstein-james-inhofe-sold-lots-of-stock-virus-fears-started/ (CBS News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] from [[Hawaii]] [[Tulsi Gabbard]] ends her [[Tulsi Gabbard 2020 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]] in the [[2020 United States presidential election|2020 presidential election]] and endorses former [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Joe Biden]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/03/19/politics/tulsi-gabbard-ends-2020-campaign/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2020 Vanuatuan general election]]
**Registered voters in [[Vanuatu]] head to the polls to elect members of [[Parliament of Vanuatu|parliament]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/412135/vanuatu-goes-to-the-polls (Radio New Zealand)]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on basketball]]
***[[2019–20 NBA season]]
****Three people employed by the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] test positive for COVID-19. [https://www.inquirer.com/health/coronavirus/three-members-sixers-organization-test-positive-covid-19-20200319.html (''The Philadelphia Inquirer'')]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on association football]]
***The suspension of [[association football|football]] games in [[England]], including the [[Premier League]] and [[English Football League]], is extended until at least April 30 due to the continued spread of the [[coronavirus|coronavirus]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/51962751 (BBC News)]
**[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on gridiron football]]
***[[Sean Payton]], the head coach of the [[New Orleans Saints]], says he has tested positive for COVID-19. [https://nypost.com/2020/03/19/saints-coach-sean-payton-tests-positive-for-coronavirus/ (''New York Post'')]
**[[2020 Summer Olympics torch relay]]
***Despite calls for the cancelation of the [[2020 Summer Olympics]] due to the ongoing coronavirus pandemic, [[Greece]] hands the [[Olympic flame]] over to [[Japan]] in a ceremony without spectators. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2020/03/074aa7d2295f-olympic-flame-to-be-handed-over-to-japan-amid-coronavirus-fears.html (Kyodo News Plus)]
